locator: Section 8, Theorem 8.1, pp.37-38; Section 12, problem (3), p.59
statement: For independent standard Gaussian vertex weights on Z^2, let M_n be the maximum weight of an n-vertex path beginning at the origin with east/north unit steps and free endpoint. Improve Var(M_n)<=C n/log n from Chatterjee's Theorem 8.1 to Var(M_n)<=C n^(1-epsilon) for some epsilon>0 and C<infinity, for every n>=2.
status_search: Source-scope correction by w495 on 2026-10-10: arXiv:0810.4221v2 section 8 treats the Gaussian ground-state maximum in 1+1 dimensions, not log Z_n in general dimension. Section 12 problem (3) asks to improve its fluctuation exponent; problem (2) separately asks about higher-dimensional chaos. Present openness UNKNOWN; finite temperature and arbitrary weights need their own statements and primary sources. Independent review pending.
title: Fluctuation exponent of directed polymers beyond the logarithmic improvement
